items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: So we go to New York to, uh... to John and Jolson's show. A show called Dancing Around. Well, if you know Jolson, you know, he always had fights with these directors, producers, and everything.

ctx.x: Then we went, then, uh... Everybody wanted us. So finally, Frank Clark of Watterson, Butler & Snyder. The music publishers. He came down with a big hot idea that he had an agent coming in town. Harry Fitzgerald. Big agent. You know, we see Fitz. So Fitz comes down. Oh, he's got it all made for a New York show. Yeah, a New York show. We go to New York to, uh... to John and Jolson's show. A show called Dancing Around. Well, if you know Jolson, you know, he always had fights with these directors, producers, and…
Did Tom Brown go with you, too?
